name: Aiur04 Temple
rules: Counts are broad optional hints, not placement quotas.
Choose decor appropriate to the scene; do not place every row.
Infrastructure and terrain features need a layout; do not scatter them.
TerrainObject IDs, Actor IDs and Model IDs are different namespaces.
Texture foliage probability is not a manual object count.
Verify target dependencies and effective palette before writing.
Vegetation and decor are disjoint Actor lists; native texture foliage is a separate Model system.

auto_vegetation_notes.meaning: Editor vegetation: native micro-model population associated with terrain textures
auto_vegetation_notes.controls: CTerrainTex.DoodadEntry + CModelFoliage and inherited Model parameters
auto_vegetation_notes.probability_is_not: percentage of map area or direct object count
auto_vegetation_notes.per_model_count: unknown; native distribution algorithm and texture masks are required
